answer: Every claim climbs the terrace of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the oasis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
